d001.note: 2400 dpi: two stacked sukun marks over the لمو cluster, no fatha on م; the upper is the lam's, the lower one sits between meem and waw so its owner cannot be fixed. Kept A's letters/marks inside an uncertainty marker (expected الْمَوْجُودَ; print error).

d002.note: 1600 dpi: no fatha over م of الإيمان nor over ق of الإيقان (B right); over the alif of بأنوار there are hamza, fatha and a hooked sukun stacked, the sukun belonging to ن (A right).

d003.note: Damma printed on the Allah ligature; case vowel printed so the Name is written with all marks (CONVENTIONS §2, precedent b17-b19, b27).

d004.note: Damma printed over each of the three Allah ligatures; written اللَّهُ per §2 and precedent.

d005.note: 2400 dpi: over تّ there are shadda, fatha and a hooked sukun stacked; the sukun belongs to ن -> التَّنْعِيم.

d006.note: Same glyph cluster as footnote (١): shadda+fatha plus displaced sukun for ن.

d007.note: Isti'adha line is in a larger heavier display font as a whole line, not contrasting bold within text; b26 (p.102) precedent wrote it without **. Kasra under ب and under the Allah ligature printed -> بِاللَّهِ per §2.

d008.note: No bold markup for the isti'adha line (see d007).

d009.note: Damma printed on the Allah ligature in «هو اللهُ الَّذِي»; written اللَّهُ per §2 and precedent.

q001.note: 1200 dpi: the quote ends at بِهَا followed directly by the closing bracket; no waqf sign ۖ is printed. Print variant (fragment cut), kept A.

u001.note: 2400 dpi: a single kasra under the لحـ ligature, between the lam foot and the hah bowl; ownership remains ambiguous, keep marker.
